test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the following sentence.

I cannot go out tonight because I __will preparing of__ my interview tomorrow.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "I will preparing of" is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be "I have to prepare for".
 
• Using the correct form of the verb "prepare" and the correct preposition "for" is essential for proper grammar.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***I cannot go out tonight because I have to prepare for__ my interview tomorrow*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to use the correct verb form and preposition in sentences to convey the intended meaning clearly and correctly.
 
• In this case, **"prepare" is the correct verb form to use, and "for" is the appropriate preposition.**
